gates.name: project_and_role_lock
gates.question: Are the goal, scope, role, exclusions, and completion boundary explicit?

gates.name: exact_user_requirement_trace
gates.question: Is the exact user instruction preserved and separated into requirement, question, correction, approval, or rejection?

gates.name: input_and_evidence_lineage
gates.question: Are every input, source, schema, status, permitted use, path, byte count, and SHA-256 pinned?

gates.name: method_preregistration
gates.question: Are method, hypothesis, metrics, falsification, resource budget, stop, and rollback conditions frozen before observing results?
required_evidence: change authorization or ADR when applicable

gates.name: contract_code_test_alignment
gates.question: Do the approved contracts, implementation, schemas, and mutation tests agree exactly?

gates.name: bounded_probe
gates.question: Does a preregistered cheap probe show active objectives, constraints, feasible reachability, and nondegenerate search before a full run?

gates.name: official_run_provenance
gates.question: Are the code, inputs, configuration, environment, seed policy, command, budget, and output namespace immutable and linked?

gates.name: raw_result_integrity
gates.question: Can every raw result be replayed with the same evaluator and exact inventory without relabeling?

gates.name: domain_quality
gates.question: Does the result pass separately approved domain, search-quality, system-performance, and claim-boundary checks?

gates.name: independent_review
gates.question: Did a role that did not author the result review exact bytes without editing the audited target?

gates.name: approved_artifact_only_integration
gates.question: Does downstream software read only an approved artifact and avoid silently recomputing scientific results?

gates.name: canonical_promotion
gates.question: Are every required gate, reproducibility check, evidence link, relevant blocker, and required promotion Git checkpoint closed before canonical or release promotion?
required_evidence: Git promotion receipt when target state requires it
